column1: # The toolchain images a project can be built with, oldest first. tools/check builds the builder FROM the one a lock
# names (with --lock), else FROM the newest, the last row here. A row is added only once its image is published.
# Each row is a C and C++ toolchain. The builders for Rust and Python are pending: their images are not published
# yet, so they have no row (docs/project-yaml.md#language).
# ubsan says how its UBSan builds choose their checks: fixed, the release's fixed flags (a project may not set
# ubsan_checks), or checks, the project's ubsan_checks or the default (docs/project-yaml.md#ubsan_checks).

column4: the toolchain the oss-fuzz-theorems 2026.10 release built its binaries in (its toolchain/toolchain.lock)
